Aisha (People Ops): Thanks everyone for the live Q&A today. Dropping this thread for follow-ups about mid-year reviews, promo timing, comp adjustments, and benefits parity. Well post an FAQ and timeline by EOD Friday.

Raj (Eng): Quick question on retroactive pay: if a promo is approved with a 7/1 effective date but payroll missed cutoff, will folks get backpay?

Olivia (Comp): Short answer: yes. We process backpay in the next payroll run once the effective date is posted in the system. It shows as a separate line item "promo adjustment". It can take one extra cycle for final accounting.

Maya (SWE): For international folks — do bands / market moves apply to EMEA/APAC the same way? We have some teammates in EUR and SGD zones.

Tom (People Ops): We do regional adjustments. Market refresh prioritizes locations where comp delta >10% vs local market medians. Equity and cash mixes may differ by locale due to local regulations; comp team will publish a region-specific FAQ after budget sign-off.

Devon (Manager): On nominations — how strict is the 2-manager rule? I have a teammate who lacks one direct peer reviewer because of small org size.

Aisha (People Ops): Not hard-blocking. If you can't get two peer reviewers, include cross-team partner feedback (PM/Design) and note why it's unavailable. Calibration chairs will accept substitutes but flag it in the packet.

Raj (Eng): Is there an appeal process if someone feels calibration missed context?

Tom (People Ops): Yes — appeals window is 10 business days after letters go out. Appeals should come from the manager with new, material evidence (metrics, customer feedback, code reviews). People Ops + calibration chair will triage and decide if a re-review is warranted.

Maya (SWE): Any change to promotion frequency? I know some teams do quarterly check-ins.

Aisha (People Ops): No change to official cadence — mid-year and end-of-year are primary cycles. Managers can nominate off-cycle for exceptional cases; those are handled case-by-case and may require an expedited packet.

Devon (Manager): Parental leave follow-up: Is top-up pay adjusted for folks on leave during review window? We want to make sure they aren't disadvantaged.

Olivia (Comp): We do not count paid parental leave as performance-negative. Leave is exempt from calibration deductions. For salary progression, managers should include return-to-work impact in the packet. If top-up eligibility overlaps with promo or comp change, comp will coordinate prorated calculations.

payroll-bot: Payroll cut-off dates: July payroll cut-off 2026-06-20; any confirmed changes after that will post in August payroll.

Aisha (People Ops): Action items: managers, attach one-line impact bullets + 2 signal lines (metrics/feedback/ownership) to each packet; flag international exceptions; keep appeals evidence handy. Well publish the FAQ, cut-off calendar, and promo packet template in #announcements by Friday EOD. Thanks all! :party_parrot:
